title: Conditional Token Framework Overview — Polymarket Documentation
quote: Each binary market has two tokens: Yes token (redeems for $1.00 pUSD if event occurs) and No token (redeems for $1.00 pUSD if event does not occur). These tokens are always fully collateralized — every Yes/No pair is backed by exactly $1.00 pUSD locked in the CTF contract. Split: Convert pUSD into matched Yes + No token pairs; Merge: Convert Yes + No pairs back into pUSD; Redeem: Exchange winning tokens for pUSD after market resolution.
